relationships.subject: miR-99b-3p
relationships.evidence_quote: overexpression of miR-99b-3p through mimic transfection significantly inhibited the inflammatory response and NLRP3-mediated pyroptosis by promoting autophagy levels in activated microglia

relationships.subject: miR-99b-3p
relationships.evidence_quote: we predicted that the 3' untranslated region (UTR) of matrix metalloproteinase-13 (Mmp13) could bind to miR-99b-3p

relationships.subject: autophagy
relationships.evidence_quote: similarly ameliorated enhanced proinflammatory cytokines expression and microglial pyroptosis by enhancing autophagy

key_findings: miR-99b-3p targets Mmp13 to promote autophagy and suppress NLRP3-mediated microglial pyroptosis, relieving CCI neuropathic pain in rats.
